snippet.title: Vault Survivors - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Vault Survivors is an upcoming roguelike survivor game where you fight endless hordes, collect powerful upgrades, and uncover the secrets of the wasteland.

This trailer showcases the demo version a glimpse of the chaos and fun waiting for you.

- Face waves of enemies
- Unlock unique weapons
- Permanent progression
- Survive as long as you can

Don’t forget to wishlist on Steam to support the game and stay updated!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3396140/Vault_Survivors/
https://zyrean.itch.io/vault-survivors
https://www.reddit.com/r/ZyreanInteractive/
